description: Example 01 with PC_ISOLATION PROCESS and PC_WORKER_TIMEOUT: 01's results in either isolation mode.

evaluations.note: As example 01 (the same search in worker processes): 16 on the reference machine since the HPO data hold the free energy and the Cauchy stress (2026-10-01; 30 before, 16 before the neighbour lists were exact). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 9 (1.015561e-01; the re-evaluation at eval 10 comes out at the rounding level below it and is the best), takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 11-12), re-evaluates the bound (13-14), takes the gradient again (15-16) and ends (status COMPLETED). Example 05, the same search with the parametric cohesive-energy script, runs to MAXEVAL = 30 instead. Whether BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation of the clamped bound depends on the sign of the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation, so the count is not pinned (evals_tol 14: 2..30, see tolerance_rationale); best loss, components and RCUT2B do not depend on it.

tolerance_rationale: Example 01's search in worker processes, with 01's tolerances: best loss, components and RCUT2B at the defaults, and the evaluation count within evals_tol 14 (2..30), for the reason given in 01's tolerance_rationale (the count at the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 depends on rounding-level noise).
